reader.requirement: At --std 85 every statement of a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure that alters the value of any control data item (of any report) must be refused, whatever the statement and whether the store reaches the item directly, through a containing group, a REDEFINES/reference-modified view, or a file record area that holds it; statements that alter no control data item are accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: the diagnostic's wording (must/shall) and citation (§1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR4 below 2002); the detection itself is edition-blind

reader.edition-search: Read CheckControlDataStores, SameStorageLine, the BindStatement funnel and the BoundStores visitor arms for READ/RETURN/WRITE/REWRITE/ACCEPT/STRING/UNSTRING/INSPECT; grepped DialectLevel in ReportWriterBinder (the 85-only CheckControlDataReferences beside it is §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR5, another rule).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: only the message text differs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb363_before_reporting_legal_store covers only the legal store; the refusal half (each storing verb, group, REDEFINES, ref-mod, READ INTO) and the file-record-area store were probed here

probes.printed: COBOL2378 on MOVE to WK, MOVE to the group, MOVE to the REDEFINES, ADD/COMPUTE to WNK, INITIALIZE, SET cond TO TRUE, STRING, INSPECT REPLACING, MOVE to WS-RED(1:2), UNSTRING, READ INTO IN-REC, and the MOVE inside IF; NOT on line 43 'READ INF AT END ...' whose record area holds control item IN-KEY (exit 65)
probes.expected: every statement that alters a control data item refused

probes.printed: compiles clean at --std 85 and --std 2023 (exit 0); run at 85 with records AA001 AA002 BB003 CC004 prints report lines [BB 003] [CC 004]: the declarative's READs replaced IN-KEY before each group was presented
probes.expected: refused: READ INF and READ INF INTO WS-X each store a record into IN-REC, altering control data item IN-KEY
stores into non-control items, including a ref-mod window of a REDEFINES that touches only WOTH, accepted and executed before each DE1

reader.notes: Every explicit store is caught, but BoundStores' READ arm (Visit(BoundRead)) counts only the INTO target, never the file's record area, unlike its RETURN arm which counts RecordArea. A control data item may be in the File Section (§1985:XIII.3.7.3 SR1 bars only the Report Section), so a READ in the USE procedure alters it unrefused.
